spans.s:
The affix अच् comes after a root ending in इ or ई (when mere action is denoted or when the sense is that of an appellative, the word being related to the verb from which its name is deduced, but not as an agent).

Terms: अच्

A semi-vowel is substituted before an affix beginning with a vowel for the final of इ or ई of a root, not preceded by a conjunct consonant forming part of the root, when the अङ्ग (stem) is mono-syllabic.

Terms: इवङ्-उवङ्
